summary: Full backend + frontend UI verification of the Bitcoin Kids landing lead-capture flow. Backend pytest suite (6/6) confirms /api/health, POST /api/leads persistence, GET /api/leads, and 400 validation. Real-browser Playwright run on the preview URL confirmed same-origin relative fetch('/api/leads') fires a POST that returns 200 application/json with _id, the DB count grows by 1 (GET /api/leads), the success toast (data-testid=success-toast) gains .show with title 'Заявка отправлена!', and the form resets. HTML5 required validation blocks empty submits (no POST fired). Telegram is not configured (telegram_configured=false) — per instructions this is NOT treated as a failure.
action_items: Configure TELEGRAM_TOKEN and TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID in /app/backend/.env when credentials are ready (currently /api/health -> telegram_configured=false); notify_telegram already handles the missing-config case gracefully.
OPTIONAL: Tailwind is loaded via cdn.tailwindcss.com — emits a production console warning. Pre-build for prod when desired.
OPTIONAL: Add rate-limiting / honeypot to POST /api/leads to prevent spam (public unauthenticated endpoint).

OPTIONAL: The catch-all `if urlPath === '/api' || urlPath.startsWith('/api/')` in server.mjs works; consider forwarding the correct upstream port explicitly (currently derived from URL, defaulting to 80 when missing — fine here because BACKEND_URL includes :8001).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: create_lead trims name/contact and returns HTTP 400 with a JSON detail when either is empty — correct. Missing fields yield FastAPI's default 422 (validated by test).
Lead model excludes _id from to_mongo() then re-assigns res.inserted_id — good, avoids ObjectId serialization issues; PyObjectId validator stringifies ObjectId for JSON output.

server.mjs proxyApi uses `target.port || 80`. Because BACKEND_URL='http://localhost:8001' the port is preserved, so this is fine. Would break silently if someone set BACKEND_URL without an explicit port to a non-80 backend — minor robustness note.
main.js validates res.ok AND json._id before showing the success toast; error branch shows a red toast. Solid.
No rate limiting / captcha on POST /api/leads — acceptable for MVP, worth adding before launch.
test_credentials: N/A — no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: Test leads prefixed 'TEST_' were inserted into the 'leads' MongoDB collection by pytest + one 'TEST_UI_<ts>' lead by the Playwright run. Safe to leave; they do not affect any user-facing flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend runs at http://localhost:8001 via supervisor; frontend at :3000 is a Node static server that proxies /api/* to the backend (server.mjs). Preview URL https://ecab7e7e-17ba-4dd9-ab52-65009c120ad5.preview.emergentagent.com serves both frontend and /api routes on the same origin. Backend tests: /app/backend/tests/test_leads_api.py (6 passing). Verified in a real Chromium: browser POST /api/leads -> 200 application/json with _id, MongoDB persists, and #toast[data-testid=success-toast] gets .show with the Russian success title. HTML `required` blocks empty submits.
rca of the issue: No issue — the flow works end-to-end. The only open item is TELEGRAM_TOKEN / TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID not being configured; leads are still saved and the notify_telegram function short-circuits with a warning log.
